title: Copper Breeze
description: You ever felt that, a boss that's made out of air, does not really fit into the trial chambers, so I made him out of copper!
body:
You ever felt that, a boss that's made out of air, does not really fit into the trial chambers, so I made him out of copper! This resourcepack changes alot of stuff, from the effects, to sound effects, to breeze itself!

Feel free to modify this resource pack as you want, but keep in mind that if you wanna upload it, **make sure to put my name there**, that's it!
